sources.title: AI clip of Chinese anti-drone system misleads online
sources.snippet: China has rapidly developed drone countermeasure technologies in recent years, but online footage supposedly showing one such system in action is AI-generated. The circulating clip was originally posted by a social media account that regularly publishes animated warfare content, while an analysis found several visual errors indicating the visual is inauthentic.
